steps.en: Staff signs in and lands in ACM only with ACM access
steps.id: Staff login dan masuk ACM hanya jika punya akses ACM
steps.why_en: Login screen and portal landing page are outside this code, and the sign-in check is not actually enforced.
steps.why_id: Layar login dan landing portal di luar kode ini, dan pengecekan login tidak benar-benar dipaksakan.

steps.en: Only AC-ADMIN staff can open Audit Trail
steps.id: Hanya staff AC-ADMIN yang bisa membuka Audit Trail
steps.why_en: Only the menu hides it; opening the page or data directly is not blocked.
steps.why_id: Hanya menu yang menyembunyikannya; membuka halaman atau data langsung tidak diblokir.

steps.en: Audit Trail page shows Action, Staff, Feature and date filters
steps.id: Halaman Audit Trail menampilkan filter Action, Staff, Feature, dan tanggal

steps.en: Results can be filtered by Add, Modify or Delete action
steps.id: Hasil bisa difilter berdasarkan aksi Add, Modify, atau Delete

steps.en: Results can be filtered by a chosen staff name
steps.id: Hasil bisa difilter berdasarkan nama staff yang dipilih

steps.en: Feature filter is accepted but does not change results
steps.id: Filter Feature diterima tetapi tidak mengubah hasil
steps.why_en: The Feature choice is shown but it does not change the result.
steps.why_id: Pilihan Feature tampil tapi tidak mengubah hasil.

steps.en: Results can be filtered by a from and to date
steps.id: Hasil bisa difilter berdasarkan tanggal awal dan akhir

steps.en: Search lists matching records in a table
steps.id: Search menampilkan data yang cocok dalam tabel
steps.why_en: Only user-role changes are listed, not changes to applications, modules, users or roles.
steps.why_id: Hanya perubahan user-role yang tampil, bukan perubahan application, module, user, atau role.

steps.en: Export button downloads the table on screen as a file
steps.id: Tombol Export mengunduh isi tabel di layar sebagai file
steps.why_en: The file is a CSV, not an Excel workbook.
steps.why_id: File berupa CSV, bukan workbook Excel.

steps.en: A failed search shows an error pop-up
steps.id: Pencarian yang gagal menampilkan pop up error
steps.why_en: The pop-up appears only for some error codes, and is a generic message.
steps.why_id: Pop up hanya muncul untuk kode error tertentu, dan pesannya generik.
